test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The total power delivered by a balanced three-phase system is ____________.

options.text: the product of the phase voltage and current of any one phase
the average of the powers in all three phases
the sum of the individual powers of any two phases
the sum of the individual powers in each phase

solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**The Total Power Delivered by a Balanced Three-Phase System**

**Definition:** In a balanced three-phase electrical system, the total power delivered to the system is the sum of the individual powers in each of the three phases. This balanced condition ensures that the load impedance is the same in all three phases, and the phase voltages are equal in magnitude and are separated by 120 degrees.

**Correct Option:** The total power delivered by a balanced three-phase system is the sum of the individual powers in each phase.
